text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Vice-President says Iraqi people appreciate French policy.
- Iraq calls for implementing fresh reforms in the U.N. Security Council.
- The Kurdistan Democratic Party announces that it will not be committed to the final statement of Ankara meeting.
- A Jordanian land transport company expresses readiness to transport goods to Iraq.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- Health Minister opens medical exhibition organised by Tunisian firms.
- Education Ministry starts shipping text books to schools in northern Iraq.
